properties.description:
'[Unvalidated] Identifies a shell or reconnaissance tool spawned
directly under a PHP worker process (php-fpm, lsphp, or Apache
mod_php, where PHP runs in-process inside the apache2/httpd worker).
This is a generic PHP child-process-monitoring indicator, useful
against any PHP RCE regardless of root cause - it does not itself
detect or confirm exploitation of CVE-2026-109618 or CVE-2026-109619
specifically.

CVE attribution is unvalidated: the reference sample this rule's
field-matching was checked against
(https://github.com/rjmendez/phpup-2026/blob/master/examples/INDEX.md)
was produced by a direct shell_exec() test endpoint, not by triggering
either CVE''s actual longjmp/bailout mechanism
(https://github.com/rjmendez/phpup-2026/blob/master/ANALYSIS.md). No
representative malicious sample produced by exploiting either CVE has
been validated against this query.

Benign-use tuning: legitimate applications routinely invoke shells,
Python, curl, or wget from PHP (build steps, package managers, image
processing, health checks). Expect overlap with existing generic
"process spawned a shell" content already present in most
environments; this rule adds PHP-worker-specific parentage as a
narrowing filter, not a new detection category. Tune the command-line
tokens and account/parent filters to your own environment before
enabling as an alert.

2026-10-21, same day, second fix: FileHash entity was mapped to this
table's SHA256 column - Microsoft's own DeviceProcessEvents schema
reference states that field "is usually not populated - use the SHA1
column when available". Switched to SHA1, confirmed as the convention
a real, already-merged detection in this same repo uses for the same
table (Detections/DeviceProcessEvents/
SolarWinds_SUNBURST_Process-IOCs.yaml).
References:
- https://github.com/php/php-src/security/advisories/GHSA-6wmf-4rv5-p3rp
- https://github.com/php/php-src/security/advisories/GHSA-w8hw-w9fx-j79w
- https://github.com/rjmendez/phpup-2026'
properties.name: PHP Worker Process Spawning Shell/Recon Tool
properties.query:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where InitiatingProcessFileName matches regex @"(?i)^(php-fpm[\d.]*|php[\d.]*|lsphp[\d]*|apache2|httpd)$"
| where FileName in~ ("sh", "bash", "dash", "zsh", "ash", "python", "python2", "python3",
    "perl", "ruby", "curl", "wget", "nc", "ncat", "nmap", "whoami", "id")
     or ProcessCommandLine has_any (
         "/bin/sh", "/bin/bash", "bash -i", "python -c", "python3 -c",
         "exec(", "eval(", "base64 -d", "curl ", "wget "
       )
| extend HashAlgorithm = "SHA1"
| project TimeGenerated, DeviceName,
          InitiatingProcessAccountName, InitiatingProcessAccountDomain,
          InitiatingProcessAccountSid,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          FileName, ProcessCommandLine, FolderPath, SHA1, HashAlgorithm
